summary: Describes 6to4 Provider Managed Tunnels, a framework operators can use to manage 6to4 tunnels in an anycast setup and improve the experience when the network is performing poorly or breaking. It is now historic and was replaced by RFC 7526.

eli5.summary: A shortcut tunnel to the IPv6 world sometimes got blocked or slow. This memo had a way for the tunnel owners to help keep it working. It is now historic.
